title: Line sketch: Surreal Bird in Vivid Abstraction
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A stylized avian figure with large circular eyes and a central beak dominates the page, surrounded by floating geometric shapes and scattered dots. Flat planes of color and sharp angular lines create dynamic movement across the off-white background. The composition balances symmetry with playful asymmetry in a bold, graphic arrangement (derived from painting #127).
